content: तर, तरण, तरणि, तरण्ड, तरि-री, तरीष <ab>&c.</ab>¦ See under तॄ.

तरीषः [तॄ-ईषन्] .²1 boat, raft. .²2 The ocean. .²3 A fit or competent person. .²4 Heaven. .²5 Work, business, practice, profession. .²6 A fine shape or form. .²7 Decorating, ornamenting. .²8 Dry cow-dung. .{@-षी@} <ab>N.</ab> of a daughter of Indra.
